generationInputs.prompt: Woodcut-style illustration: A skeletal figure in black armor and a helmet with a red plume rides a white horse. The figure, turned to the right, holds a black banner featuring a stylized white rose with five petals and a yellow center. The horse has a black bridle and saddle. Beneath the horse's front legs, a young girl with brown hair in pigtails, wearing a blue dress, looks up with clasped hands. To her right, an older male figure with light skin tone and gray hair under a yellow and green patterned robe and hat kneels in prayer with clasped hands. Further right, a light-skinned figure lies on the ground, wrapped in a white shroud. The ground is green with stylized yellow and blue vegetation and water details. In the background, a yellow sun rises or sets over a landscape with flat blue water and green land. The illustration features bold black outlines and flat areas of bright yellow, orange, green, red, and blue color hues on a white background, reminiscent of traditional block printing.
